scenario.limitations: Scenario uses user-entered payroll and rates; ECB tracker is an aggregate negotiation indicator, not a firm-specific accounting accrual.

hypothesis: Wage agreements can create a timing and recognition problem: headline negotiated growth and permanent recurring pay need not match.
alternative: Coverage of the ECB tracker varies materially by horizon; one-off timing, headcount and social costs affect actual accruals.
falsifier: Payroll records, contracts and accrual schedules reconcile recurring and one-off payments without unexplained variances.
